subject: Coffee & Tea
title: Single-Origin vs. Blends
description: A quick win: understand Single-Origin vs. Blends.

hook.text: English Breakfast is a blend of teas from India, Kenya, and Sri Lanka. It's designed for consistency, not terroir.

buildup.text: Blenders mix teas from many sources to hit a target flavor profile that stays the same year after year.

discovery.text: Single-origin teas vary by season and year—like wine vintages. Each harvest is unique and unrepeatable.

twist.text: Most tea drinkers prefer blends without knowing it. Consistency is comforting; terroir is adventurous.

climax.text: Both approaches have value. Blends offer reliability; single-origin offers discovery and connection to place.

punchline.text: Blends for comfort. Single-origin for exploration. Choose both.

quiz.question: Why do tea companies create blends?
options: To achieve a consistent flavor profile across seasons and years
Single-origin tea is illegal to sell
